Space Soldiers was a Turkish esports organization. The team competed in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and was founded in 2015 by Bünyamin Aydın and Edis Aydın. After 3 years of presence the team lost their players after a contract dispute.

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2015
  • 2016
  • 2017
  • 2018
  • Show All
  • January 17 - Space Soldiers go official. TuGuX, e1, XANTARES, DESPE, and ONLY join. [1]
  • January 5th - After having used ngiN as a stand-in for e1 for several events, e1 officially leaves the team. [2]
  • February 11th - ONLY is removed from the team. [3]
  • February 18th - paz joins as a stand-in. [4]
  • November 11th - TuGuX leaves. [5]
  • November 26th - Space Soldiers trial MAJ3R as their new fifth. [6]
  • February 8th - MAJ3R's trial period ends and he signs with Space Soldiers. [7]
  • February 13th - Space Soldiers add Calyx as their sixth man. [8]
  • October 13th - The Space Soldiers players refuse to continue playing under the organization, and therefore go inactive. [9][10]
  • December 22nd - XANTARES is acquired by BIG. [11]
